# Every ssl listener needs an explicit protocols line.
# The pattern spans groups of blocks; findings land on the first and last.
# ruleid: missing-ssl-version
server {
    listen 443 ssl;

}
server {
    listen 8443 ssl;

}
server {
    listen 9443 ssl;

}
# ruleid: missing-ssl-version
server {
    listen 10443 ssl;

}
# ok: missing-ssl-version
# TLS versions are pinned in the http block instead.
# ok: missing-ssl-version
ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
